comments.body:
The proposal is important, so do it well and with some thought behind it! However, once u get the scholarship the proposal is irrelevant. You can do the topic you proposed if you wish, but you can also do something totally different. I did something COMPLETELY different 🤣.

If u get an ETH professor on board, thats probably helpful but not required. For my application, I didnt have one.

Good luck!
comments.author: Nauckle225
